name: Redemption's Road

start.dialog: I was a tool of darkness once. Did terrible things. Now I seek the light... but the path is blocked. Three trials in the desert. Three guardians. Help me face them? I cannot do this alone.
start.objective: Accompany Cecil to defeat the three desert guardians

progress.dialog: Two guardians remain. The path to redemption is... painful. But necessary.
progress.objective: Defeat the second guardian with Cecil's aid

complete.dialog: The third guardian... fallen. And I feel... different. Lighter. Thank you. Take this - my old dark sword. I no longer need it. May it serve you better than it served me.

party_comments.kade: Seeking redemption... I understand that path.
party_comments.korr: A knight who admits wrongdoing. Rare. Admirable.
party_comments.vex: The light accepts those who truly repent. He has earned his peace.

hidden_outcome: If you spare all three guardians instead of defeating them, Cecil becomes a Paladin and gives you 'Holy Fang' sword instead
